title: School Calendar Double-Booking for Caregivers
dataSources: Nanit sleep sessions (`nanit:sleep`), Hatch routines (`hatch:routine`), school calendar events (`schoolcalendar:event`), allowance transactions (`allowance:txn`), and kid screen usage (`screentime:usage`).
app: Family-routine telemetry from Nanit sleep exports, Hatch routine data, school calendars, allowance and chore apps, and Apple Screen Time sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=schoolcalendar:event
| stats count(eval(conflict="true")) as conflicts dc(event_id) as events by caregiver_name
| sort 0 - conflicts
value: Calendar conflict counts highlight where the family handoff plan is too brittle.
implementation: Send caregiver double-bookings events to `index=personal` and keep `caregiver_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of caregiver double-bookings by caregivers.
grandmaExplanation: It totals which caregiverss stand out most for caregiver double-bookings.
